items.name: menu-list
items.title: MenuList
items.description: YoRHa system-menu list: roving-focus listbox or navigation list with a left-to-right ink wipe, square bullet, arrow cursor, rules and staggered entry. Per-row render prop for router links.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Sound cues (cursor-move, select) are opt-in: pass `sound` and enable them in <YorhaProvider sound={{ enabled: true }}>. Thin rules follow the --menu-rule token (0 hides them).
